name: squeek-life
description: Squeek Life — From Rags to Riches. Pixel-art life-sim adventure game for Squeekchain. Static frontend lives in frontend/, optional Express API in backend/.

scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && BASE_PATH=./ npm run build:client && cd .. && rm -rf dist && cp -r frontend/dist/client dist
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && BASE_PATH=./ npm run build:client
